convention.name: revision_is_change_in_linear_cost
convention.invariant: c_D + delta == -z_A for every event; asserted, not assumed

convention.name: revision_is_change_in_linear_cost
convention.invariant: c_D + delta == -z_A for every event; asserted, not assumed

cohorts.label: post-results reanalysis of the preregistered 2015-01-01 .. 2024-06-30 test split; the period had already been inspected when these corrections were made

cri_immateriality_certificate.method: CRI regret bound <= tau (validated upper bound)
cri_immateriality_certificate.note: an upper bound above tau is a failure to certify, never a materiality claim

cri_with_witness.method: CRI certificate + greedy feasible-descent materiality witness

no_recompute.method: no recomputation (asserts regret 0 for every event)

workflows.runtime_definition: per event; audit stage only, then including program compilation, then including the original decision solve

kkt_only.method: KKT stability only (dual recovery + feasibility check, no descent)

osqp_resolve.method: OSQP re-solve (ground truth for the regret, no certificate)

prospective_audit_base.question: prospective: if a further correction of typical size arrived after the audit vintage, would the decision still be certifiably immaterial?
prospective_audit_base.containment_note: not measurable with two vintages: the set is about a correction that has not arrived yet

prospective_decision_base.question: prospective: if the total correction were any vector in a symmetric box around no change, would the decision be certifiably immaterial?
prospective_decision_base.containment_note: measured against the observed cost revision; the guarantee is conditional on containment

postaudit_observed_centre.question: post-audit: given the observed revision, and that it is itself wrong by a typical revision error, is the decision certifiably immaterial?
postaudit_observed_centre.containment_note: contains the observed revision by construction; whether it contains any *later* correction is not measured here

revision_magnitude.note: a heuristic ranking/flag, never a certificate

first_order_estimate.note: a heuristic ranking/flag, never a certificate

cri_bound.note: a heuristic ranking/flag, never a certificate

magnitude.note: features are computed from the recorded decision and the revision only

metadata.note: features are computed from the recorded decision and the revision only

geometry_no_radius.note: features are computed from the recorded decision and the revision only

geometry_projection.note: features are computed from the recorded decision and the revision only

geometry_full.note: includes the bracketing search of KKT tests needed by the directional radius

prediction.model: ridge logistic regression (l2=1) on the train split; AUC is rank-based on the test split, ties count one half

functional_equivalence.note: both arms carry the same decision state and provenance (recorded weights, decision-time costs, clocks, vintages, horizon, digests) and the same shared block; the CRI arm adds the multipliers and the revision delta, the re-solve arm adds the audit-time cost vector, which is the input of the same size

cri_u.half_width_source: train split only (2000-2012); test events never enter the width
